name: Blackstone
description: Blackstone is the world's largest alternative asset manager, with about $1.27 trillion of assets under management in real estate, private equity, credit and insurance, and hedge-fund allocation. It earns base management fees on the capital investors commit or hold with it, plus performance revenues (carried interest and incentive fees) when investments are sold at a gain, and a smaller return on its own money invested in its funds. Fee-related earnings are the steady part; realized performance revenues swing with how many deals it can exit. Investors include pensions and sovereign funds and, increasingly, individuals through perpetual vehicles such as BCRED (private credit).

employees.note: Approximately 5,285 people including 268 senior managing directors (10-K).

businessLines.name: Real Estate
businessLines.how: Investors commit capital to funds (and perpetual vehicles) and pay a base management fee on it each year; Blackstone also takes carried interest (a share of profits) when properties are sold.

revenue.period: FY2025 (year ended 2025-12-31), total segment revenue (computed: management and advisory fees net + fee-related performance revenues + realized performance revenues + realized principal investment income)

businessLines.name: Private Equity
businessLines.how: Base fees on drawn and committed capital in buyout, infrastructure, life-sciences, growth and secondaries funds, plus large carried-interest payouts when portfolio companies are sold (realized performance revenues were 1,670.1 of this segment's revenue).

revenue.period: FY2025 (year ended 2025-12-31), total segment revenue (computed: management and advisory fees net + fee-related performance revenues + realized performance revenues + realized principal investment income)

businessLines.name: Credit & Insurance (BXCI)
businessLines.how: Management fees on corporate and asset-based credit funds, BDCs (BCRED, BXSL) and insurance-company mandates, plus fee-related performance revenues (incentive fees on the credit funds) that recur and so count in fee-related earnings.

revenue.period: FY2025 (year ended 2025-12-31), total segment revenue (computed: management and advisory fees net + fee-related performance revenues + realized performance revenues + realized principal investment income)

businessLines.name: Multi-Asset Investing (BXMA)
businessLines.how: Fees for allocating client money across hedge funds and other public and private strategies, plus performance fees on top; the world's largest discretionary allocator to hedge funds per the 10-K.

revenue.period: FY2025 (year ended 2025-12-31), total segment revenue (computed: management and advisory fees net + fee-related performance revenues + realized performance revenues + realized principal investment income)

brands.name: BCRED (Blackstone Private Credit Fund)
brands.note: Non-traded BDC in Credit & Insurance; accounted for $1.2 billion of Management and Advisory Fees, Net and Incentive Fees in 2025, about 13 percent of the 9,053.8 million of those two GAAP lines combined (computed from 8,075.6 + 978.2)

brands.name: BXSL (Blackstone Secured Lending Fund)
brands.note: Publicly traded BDC managed by Credit & Insurance

brands.name: BREIT
brands.note: Non-traded REIT; in 2023 accounted for $839.9 million of Management and Advisory Fees, Net (10-K major customer note)
